newsitem.title: UK: SEI to open new Scottish freight terminal.
newsitem.headline: SEI to open new Scottish freight terminal.

text.p: Scottish Express International (SEI), a division of Securicor Distribution said in a statement it will open a new six millon international freight terminal on September 11th.

The facility is the first to be located at the Scottish Eurocentral site, a new business park situated in Mossend, Lanarkshire and next to the new Railfreight terminal. The latter also provides Scotland's first non-stop rail-link to Continental Europe.

SEIs core operations now located at Dundonald, Glasgow and Edinburgh, will be amalgamated and moved to the new site. Operations at these three locations will continue to operate exclusively for inbound airfreight and value-added services, it added.
